task.title: Deploying the Red Hat Quay registry by using the OpenShift Container Platform web console
task.shortdesc: To deploy a basic Red Hat Quay registry instance, you can use the OpenShift Container Platform web console to create a QuayRegistry custom resource. You configure managed or unmanaged object storage during the deployment process.

ul.li: You have installed the Red Hat Quay Operator.
You have have administrative privileges to the cluster.

step.cmd: On the OpenShift Container Platform web console, click Operators → Installed Operators → Red Hat Quay.
On the Red Hat Quay dashboard, click Create instance.
On the Create QuayRegistry page, review the default settings of the QuayRegistry custom resource (CR). Here, you decide whether to to use managed or unmanaged object storage.

Click the name of the Red Hat Quay registry that you created, then click Events to view the status of creation. If you used managed storage and leveraged the Multicloud Object Gateway, the registry completes creation.
